type_reason: First matched-filter search for eccentric BBHs with a new EOB template bank, run on public O3 strain.
headline: 28 BBH events at FAR below 1 per 100 yr in O3, all already in GWTC-3 and 4-OGC, and a 90% rate upper limit below 0.06 Gpc^-3 yr^-1 for 30+30 Msun BBHs at eccentricity 0.5.

F1.quote: This result is directly com- parable with the sensitive distance from the L VK O3 minimal modeled search (Abac et al. 2024), which ob- tains 1.3 Gpc
F1.scope: Searched Sec 5 and abstract for what the sensitive-distance comparison is made against.
F1.note: Rate limit uses the authors own injection campaign (standard VT), but the improvement claim is made against a separate LVK published number, not a reference built from the same setup.

F2.scope: Read abstract, Sec 5 and Fig 4 caption.
F2.note: Abstract headlines the 30+30, e=0.5 limit (<0.06) which is the lowest cell of the Fig 4 grid, but states the mass range [5,30] and the full grid is in Fig 4 and the release. Not clearly a hidden spread.

F3.quote: we detect 28 signifi- cant BBH events with a F AR less than once every 100 yr
F3.scope: Searched abstract, Sec 4 and conclusion for detection claims.
F3.note: The 28 detections carry FAR; the one new candidate is given FAR of 1 per 2.3 yr and is called a subthreshold candidate.

F4.quote: The search results and all scripts necessary to re- produce this work are released in https://github.com/
F4.scope: Searched whole text for github, zenodo, data availability.
F4.note: Search results and scripts released. Inputs are public GWOSC strain.

F5.quote: we constrain the event rate to be<0.06
F5.scope: Recounted Table 1 rows and recomputed the rate limit from printed inputs.
F5.note: Table 1 has 44 rows: 28 with inverse FAR >= 100 yr and 16 between 1 and 100 yr, matching the text. 2.3/VT with sensitive distance 2.4 Gpc and 0.67 yr: V=4/3*pi*2.4^3=57.9 Gpc^3, VT=38.8, R90=0.059, rounds to 0.06. Factor 2 in distance (2.4/1.3=1.85) and 8 in volume as printed (2^3).

F6.scope: Compared abstract with Table 1, Fig 4 and body.
F6.note: Prose against prose only. Abstract: "this marks a 1 order of magnitude improvement for sensitive volume". Body: "our search improves by a factor of 2 for ~30 Msun eccentric BBHs, or equivalently, the sensitive volume by a factor of 8". Abstract unit "Gpc-3 yr-1" vs body "Gpc-1 yr-1" (typo). Table 1 and Fig 4 values agree with the 28/44 counts and 0.06.

F7.scope: The paper is itself a matched-filter search.
F7.note: No claim against a simpler method; it compares with an LVK minimally modelled search for sensitive volume only.

type_reason: Re-derives H0 from public GWTC-3 BBH posteriors with galaxy cluster catalogues in the authors adapted gwcosmo.
headline: H0 = 77 (+10,-10) and 81 (+8,-8) km/s/Mpc with PSZ2 and eRASS cluster catalogues, 10% and 38% better precision than the galaxy-catalogue result.
released: inputs only: GWTC-3 posteriors, GLADE+, PSZ2, eRASS (all third-party)

F1.quote: leadtoimprovementsonprecisionof 10%and 38%overthetraditionalresult from the GLADE+ galaxy catalogue
F1.scope: Searched abstract, Sec 4, Fig 3 and 4 captions for how the precision gain is referenced.
F1.note: The 10% and 38% gains are measured against GLADE+ and empty-catalogue H0 results that the authors compute in the same adapted gwcosmo setup on the same events (76 +11 -11), not a separate published value. Moderate confidence; the reference is a standard baseline.

F2.quote: We infer 𝐻0 values of 77+10−10 and 81+8−8kms−1Mpc−1 respectively with PSZ2 and eRASS catalogues
F2.note: Headline H0 values are given with 68% intervals beside them, for both catalogues.

F3.note: A precision comparison, not a detection or deviation claim. Gain factors printed without an interval.

F4.quote: All of the GW events that are used in this analysis are avail- able at https://gwosc.org/GWTC-3/.
F4.scope: Read Data Availability and whole text for github, zenodo, code.
F4.note: Data Availability lists only the third-party inputs (GWTC-3, GLADE+, PSZ2, eRASS). No link to the adapted gwcosmo, the cluster-catalogue prior or the H0 posteriors. Moderate confidence.

F5.quote: the 𝐻0 uncertaintiesshrinkby factors of1.10 and 1.38
F5.scope: Recomputed the printed precision gains from the printed intervals.
F5.note: Same-kind ratio of printed uncertainties: 11/10=1.10 and 11/8=1.375 -> 1.38, matching "1.10 and 1.38" and 10% / 38%.

F6.scope: Compared abstract with Sec 4 text and Fig 4 caption.
F6.note: Abstract and Fig 4 caption agree (10%, 38%); Fig 4 curves cannot be read from the extraction.

F7.note: Would need the gwcosmo run on the same events.

type_reason: New sampler (persistent sampling / pocomc) validated against nested sampling on simulated and public GWOSC events.

released: data release with code, simulated data and full results (Zenodo, per Data Availability)

F1.quote: we analyse the same injections using dynesty, as implemented in bilby with the settings de- tailed in table A4
F1.scope: Searched Sec 5 and Sec 6 for the nested-sampling reference.
F1.note: The speed and consistency headline is measured against dynesty runs the authors do on the same 100 simulated injections they generate, with their own settings. Moderate confidence; standard sampler benchmark.

F2.note: Headline is an average, with the 100-event spread stated in the body (two to seven times, with standard deviations).

F3.quote: for all 15 parameters lie within the 3-𝜎 uncertainties and the combined 𝑝-values computed using Fishers’s method
F3.note: The consistency claim carries p-values and sigma bands; no detection claim.

F4.quote: The data release including code to reproduce the figure and analyses as well as the simu- lated data and the full results is available online
F4.note: Code, simulated data and full results released.

F5.scope: Recomputed the abstract averages from the printed per-network means.
F5.note: Efficiency (1.92+2.09)/2=2.005 -> 2. Wall time per sample (2.63+2.84)/2=2.735 -> 2.74 (rounding at the boundary). Means of per-network means, equal event counts assumed.

F6.scope: Compared abstract with Sec 5 text and Fig 7 and 8.
F6.note: Abstract agrees with body prose; Fig 8 values cannot be read from the extraction.

F7.scope: The claim is a sampler comparison, not a search against a matched filter.
